page.overview:
What is Adventure Springtrap?

is an unlockable character in FNaF World.

Springtrap is an olive rabbit animatronic with gray eyes, appearing as a smaller version of his counterpart from the Five Nights at Freddy's series. He has several holes and wires poking out, and wears a single button. He also wears the large portion of his ear that was once gone from the original game. The innards of William Afton inside him are noticeably missing. He also has four fingers, rather than five. He bears regular animatronic feet, while his original counterpart had bare endoskeleton feet from the shin down.

Springtrap is a good character, mainly useful for damaging enemies. Bite 2 can do solid damage, while Rainy Day helps the party members by lowering all the enemies' defenses.

His best attack is Springlocks, which can do 100 to 1500 damage to an enemy and other nearby. This makes Springtrap a very powerful character to use, as a hard hitting character is required in the team. However, Adventure Spring Bonnie makes a great alternative.
